newsBlurb.text: Seattle limps home from Washington carrying a rare loss, one built on a stalled running game and three turnovers that handed the Commanders 21 points — exactly the sloppiness Mike Macdonald's group has to scrub before the Chargers arrive. The secondary could get reinforcements: Julian Love, sidelined by a calf injury suffered in practice, drew a "day to day" tag from Macdonald after encouraging Monday work. How the offense reestablishes the run will shape everything else in this one.
